parameters.name: DeploymentSetIds
parameters.description: The IDs of deployment sets. The value can be a JSON array that consists of multiple deployment set IDs in the format of `["ds-xxxxxxxxx", "ds-yyyyyyyyy", … "ds-zzzzzzzzz"]`. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: DeploymentSetName
parameters.description: The name of the deployment set. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters that are categorized as letter in Unicode, including English letters, Chinese characters, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the deployment set list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the deployment set. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Strategy
parameters.description:
The deployment strategy. Valid values:

- Availability: high availability.
- AvailabilityGroup: high availability for deployment set groups.
- LowLatency: low network latency.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The deployment type. Valid values:
- host: physical server
- sw: vSwitch
- rack: rack

Default value: host.
